summary: Third regression pass after 3 code-quality patches (role-array constants in App.js, useMemo AuthProvider value in auth.jsx, WEEKDAYS key idx->label in AdminDashboard.jsx). All targeted regressions PASS. Backend: POST /api/auth/login admin -> 200 + cookie; GET /api/auth/me -> admin; GET /api/rooms + /api/settings/public 200; POST /api/bookings/public created LAB-2026-0010. Frontend: /masuk admin login redirects to /dasbor/admin (proves ProtectedRoute + ROLES_* constant refactor OK). Admin can navigate to /dasbor/kepala-labor and /dasbor/tu (proves ROLES_KEPALA_LABOR/ROLES_TU arrays include admin correctly). Admin > Jam & Libur tab renders 7 weekday rows (Senin..Minggu) each with Buka checkbox + start/end time inputs (proves WEEKDAYS.map key=label works). Toggling day-open-0 checkbox saved with 'Tersimpan' toast; state persisted to backend (verified via GET /api/settings/public showing updated open flag), then restored. Logout button clicked -> redirected to /masuk and /dasbor/admin now bounces to /masuk (proves useMemo-wrapped AuthProvider value did not break login/logout flow). /cek-status search-by-code returns booking info (LAB- present in DOM). No console errors observed.

No React key warnings or console errors observed

Backend booking flow re-verified directly via POST /api/bookings/public which produced LAB-2026-0010 successfully, confirming end-to-end booking is not regressed.
Schedule state modified during test (day-open-0 toggled) was restored to True at end of test.
